entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Returns'.
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Hi, you've reached Alex at VeloFit. I can help you today. Do you have an order number?
Yes. VF-987-6543. I need to return a VeloBand.
Okay, I'm pulling that up now. I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
No fault. I just don't want it. So, can you send me a return label or not?
I understand. One moment while I review the purchase details... Okay, I see the item was delivered to you on December 15th, which was 27 days ago.
And? I just want to return it.
Well, sir, according to our records, I'm afraid it's too late to start a return for this specific item.
What do you mean 'too late'? Your website says 10 days. I'm a VIP member. I know the policy.

I absolutely recognize and appreciate your status as a VIP member, and you're correct that our standard policy for most apparel and gear is 10 days. However, the VeloBand Pulse is an exception due to health and safety reasons.
That makes no sense. It's practically new.

The return policy for the Pulse is strictly 10 days. Because it's a wearable device that maintains direct skin contact, we have to adhere to very strict hygiene protocols. After that window, we cannot accept it back for sanitation reasons.
So you're just saying no. I've wasted my time calling.

I am very sorry, but yes, for this item, the return policy is firm and I cannot process a refund. The request is outside the allowable timeframe. While I can't help with the return, I do want to thank you for your loyalty. As a VIP, I can offer you a 25% credit for your next jersey or accessory purchase with us.
Forget it. I'll just sell it online. This is ridiculous. Goodbye.
I understand your frustration. I'm sorry we couldn't resolve this for you today. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
